# M1 STEP acceptance fixture

`injection_plate_with_hole.step` is a synthetic, non-sensitive fixture made
with CadQuery: a 30 x 20 x 6 mm rectangular solid with a 4 mm through-hole.
Its SHA-256 is
`d4d9c9729564172eb00751afb08aa9822539782d3c29740edbc38f4f0dd29231`.

The profile freezes the values in `injection.legacy-baseline@1.0.0`. The
fixture is used only for compatibility and vertical-slice acceptance; its
findings are not a customer or regulatory standard.
